# deps: tools: up octosql to v0.8.1

Pin `octosql` at v0.8.1 in the Go toolset, following [#340](DOT-339.md) (v0.8.0). OctoSQL is the SQL-over-anything CLI ([#97](DOT-96.md)); the upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), with the `replace` directives of [#312](DOT-311.md) to keep in step. The release notes are the [v0.8.1 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.8.1).
